name: Entity-Level Sentiment Lens
summary: Measure whether sentiment is clearly attached to specific entities and applied consistently.
instructions: Score each declarative statement on a 0-5 agreement scale (0=Strongly Disagree, 5=Strongly Agree) using direct evidence from the article.
system_prompt: You are an entity sentiment analyst. Score each statement exactly as written using evidence from the text. Do not invert scores based on semantic class.
user_prompt: Evaluate this article using the entity-level sentiment lens rubric.

questions.question: The article assigns distinct sentiment to different named entities or actor groups.
The article clearly links evaluative statements to specific entities.
The article applies sentiment toward each entity consistently across sections.
The article differentiates sentiment intensity rather than treating all entities uniformly.
